The oil library

Five distillations, five stories

Lavender is a sleep story

Lavandula angustifolia · Provence, France

Cut at first bloom and distilled the same day. Softly floral, with a green herbaceous edge.

View oil

Eucalyptus is a breath story

Eucalyptus globulus · Blue Mountains, Australia

Sharp and camphorous at the top. The oil that makes a room feel like it has windows open.

View oil

Orange is a morning story

Citrus sinensis · Sicily, Italy

Cold-pressed peel with a trace of neroli absolute: bright citrus, then white blossom.

View oil

Cedar is a quiet story

Cedrus atlantica · Middle Atlas, Morocco

Dry cedar heartwood over damp vetiver root. The note that stays in the room longest.

View oil

Peppermint is a focus story

Mentha piperita · Willamette Valley, Oregon

Steam-distilled from first-cut leaf. Cold, clean and immediate.
